details.label: Today's Hazards
details.text: Today and tonight. A strong cold front will cross the area today. A line of showers and embedded thunderstorms is expected to develop along the front from late morning into the afternoon. There is a Marginal Risk, or level 1 out of 5, for damaging winds with some of these storms. In addition, outside of any showers or storms, wind could gust near 45 mph at times across eastern Tucker county West Virginia this afternoon into this evening.

details.label: Extended Outlook
details.text: Saturday through Thursday. A widespread frost is expected Saturday night into Sunday morning, with a freeze possible as temperature drop into the lower 30s. Frost is possible again Sunday night into Monday morning.
